NONE: › relating to or arranged in zones
地帶的，區域性的；分成區的
B1 an area, especially one that is different from the areas around it because it has different characteristics or is used for different purposes
（尤指有不同特徵或用途的）地帶，地區
› to give a special purpose to a particular area, such as an area in a town
將…劃作特殊區域；指定…為某項用途的區域
› specialized geography, environment one of the five parts the earth is divided into according to temperature, marked by imaginary lines going around it from east to west

example: He was charged with driving at 75 mph in a 55 mph zone.
他被指控在限速55英里的區域內駕車時速達到75英里。
This stretch of coast has been designated a danger zone.
這段海岸已被劃定為危險地帶。
The UN Security Council has established a no-fly zone (= one where aircraft are not permitted to fly).
聯合國安全理事會設定了一處禁飛區。
The former dockyard has been zoned for industrial use.
以前的造船廠被辟為了工業用地。

NONE: › in basketball and some other sports, a system of defending in which each player is responsible for defending an area rather than an opposing player
› to stop paying attention and not hear or see what is around you for a short period of time

example: When the men start talking about football, I just zone out.
男人們一開始談論足球，我就走神了。

NONE: › the act of deciding, or the decision that has been taken about, what particular use an area should have
極度疲憊的；筋疲力盡的

example: We were really zonked (out) after our long journey.
長途旅行之後，我們真的是筋疲力盡了。
